clue.text: May be edgy about soldiers wanting a lot

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go about, that is around, the soldiers
the letters of edgy may be some other word, so they are to be rearranged

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder
RE is the Royal Engineers, a stock crossword unit of soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops who want a great deal might well feel tense and on edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'May be' reads as a hedge on the soldiers' mood, but it tells you edgy is to be reshuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone greedy has an excessive desire for more than they need, wanting a lot.

clue.text: Draw breath as doctor comes round

indicators.note: the doctor comes round, that is surrounds, the little word as

parts.note: GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor in Britain
taken as written

explanation.surface: A patient takes a sharp breath when the doctor arrives on a visit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comes round' suggests a home visit or a patient waking; it is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To gasp is to take a sudden sharp intake of breath, a synonym of drawing breath.

clue.text: Feeling when bestseller is brought up

indicators.note: in a down entry, bringing something up means writing it from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a bestseller is a No. 1 tome, read as NO, I and TOME

explanation.surface: Someone gets emotional when a bestselling book is mentioned in conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: A bestseller is the number one book: NO I TOME, with I the Roman numeral for one.
explanation.definitionFit: An emotion is a feeling such as joy or anger, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Delaware's inheritance provided for a group of representatives

parts.note: DE is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Delaware
a legacy is something inherited under a will

explanation.surface: A US state's inheritance pays for a committee of delegates.
explanation.definitionFit: A delegacy is a body of delegates, people appointed to act as representatives for others.

clue.text: Stage designed for a drop

explanation.surface: A theatre stage built to take a drop curtain.
explanation.walkthrough: A drop in the theatre is a painted backcloth; here it is the fall of a hanged person.
explanation.definitionFit: A scaffold is the raised platform on which executions by hanging were carried out.

clue.text: Middle bit is the focus of attention

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a piece placed in the centre, as on a dining table
second meaning: the most important or eye-catching feature of something

explanation.walkthrough: Read literally the answer splits into two words meaning the middle bit.
explanation.definitionFit: A table decoration set in the middle is also the star feature that draws everyone's attention.

clue.text: Someone you know to be a right little devil outside

parts.note: a fiend is a devil or demon, here a mischievous one

clue.text: Too much weight put on having to follow the rules and sit inside

indicators.note: the word sit goes inside the word for following rules

parts.note: to obey is to do as the rules require
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone piles on the pounds by sitting indoors and doing as they are told.
explanation.definitionFit: Obesity is the condition of being seriously overweight, having gained excess body fat.

clue.text: Specify plan before tea is served

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Instructions to name a plan before afternoon tea arrives.

clue.text: Ruined when indulged

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as overindulgence causing ruin; the two words are separate meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes both something damaged and a child pampered to excess.

clue.text: Those who don't believe in Castro and the start of socialism

parts.note: taken as written

parts.note: the word whose opening letter is taken

explanation.surface: Sceptics who have no faith in Castro or in socialism itself.

clue.text: Making a digital record

definitions.meaning: the act of creating a record
sounds like computer data, but digital here means of the fingers

explanation.walkthrough: Digital suggests computers; it means made with the digits, the fingers.
explanation.definitionFit: Police take prints of a suspect's fingertips to keep an identifying record.

clue.text: Sent somewhere else to study doctor developing seeds

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university

indicators.note: the seeds are developing, changing shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A student is posted elsewhere to research how a doctor's seeds grow.

clue.text: Hot and cold, the girl accepted Prince's welcoming gestures

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the girl accepts, taking in, the letter for prince

explanation.surface: A girl who blows hot and cold still takes the prince's friendly greetings.

explanation.definitionFit: Handclasps are grips of the hand, a common gesture of welcome or greeting.

clue.text: Plain-speaking robbers

people who seize what is not theirs

explanation.walkthrough: Plain sounds like plane, and the answer splits as the greeting 'Hi Jack', so these robbers speak to planes.
explanation.definitionFit: Hijackers are criminals who seize control of an aircraft or vehicle in transit.

clue.text: Mark got some comeback from the bird

indicators.note: a comeback turns the word around so it reads backwards

parts.note: any means some, as in 'got any?'

explanation.surface: Mark received a retort from the bird he was talking to.
explanation.walkthrough: Mark is the abbreviation M, as in a German mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The myna is an Asian starling known for mimicking human speech.

clue.text: What volunteer welfare worker gives without worrying?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: read as two words, care given at no charge
second meaning: untroubled, having no anxieties

explanation.walkthrough: A volunteer gives care for free; run the two words together for the second meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: A carefree person is light-hearted and untroubled, free of anxieties.

clue.text: Magistrate accepts a first edition as a joke

indicators.note: the magistrate accepts, taking in, the other letters

indicators.note: just the opening letter of edition

parts.note: the word whose opening letter is taken

explanation.surface: A judge takes in a first edition as a prank.
explanation.definitionFit: A jape is a practical joke or prank, a playful trick.

clue.text: Suggest writing about work

indicators.note: the writing goes about, around, the short word for a work

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language

clue.text: Lie near and stir the hormone

parts.note: the three words taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Lying close and stirring things up gets the blood pumping.

clue.text: Cryptic clue: "Din will bring it in"

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder
taken as written as anagram fodder

explanation.walkthrough: 'Cryptic clue' looks like a heading for the quotation; Cryptic is the signal and clue is fodder.

clue.text: Chops, stewed with last of gravy, for a Hannibal Lecter?

explanation.walkthrough: Hannibal Lecter is the cannibal killer of The Silence of the Lambs, hence the cooking.

clue.text: Angry allusion to linked material

explanation.surface: An irritable mention of a connected document.

explanation.definitionFit: A cross-reference in a book directs the reader to another place with related information.

clue.text: Chief stretch of water

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an adjective for most important and a literary name for the open ocean.

clue.text: Shock treatment of art for university degree

clue.text: I object with churchman about lower status

definitions.note: a verb phrase, to lower the status of
